hints.code: A lower-case letter, then 3–32 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens in all; fixed once the tenant is opened
hints.package: The tenant may use only what its package holds
hints.expiresAt: Leave empty for no end; once it ends the tenant is disabled and its data kept
hints.userQuota: Leave empty for no limit; the administrator counts
hints.domains: Press Enter to add; signing in on these domains enters this tenant. No scheme or port, at most 20
hints.brandName: Leave empty to use the system name
hints.logo: Leave empty to use the system logo
hints.admin: Created with the tenant, holding the tenant administrator role; the initial password must be changed at the first sign-in
hints.defaultFixed: The default tenant cannot be disabled or given an expiry or a package

created.title: Tenant opened
created.hint: The initial password is shown this once only. Save it now and pass it to the tenant administrator; if it is lost, reset it

resetPassword.confirm: Reset the initial password of tenant {name}?
resetPassword.title: New initial password
resetPassword.hint: The initial password is shown this once only. Save it now

tenant.copyFailed: Copying failed. Please select and copy it by hand
tenant.disableConfirm: The users of tenant {name} are signed out at once and cannot sign in; its data is kept. Disable it?

enter.title: Enter tenant: {name}
enter.reasonPlaceholder: Why you need to enter this tenant, e.g. the ticket you are looking into
enter.hint: Inside it you work on the tenant's data with your own permissions (no platform features); everything you do is audited, and you leave it automatically after 2 hours.
